title: Starship Troopers
author: Robert A. Heinlein
summary: A young man joins the Mobile Infantry in a future where only veterans can vote, and takes part in a war against insect-like aliens. The book follows his training, his battles and his ideas about duty.
readIf: you want a lean military science-fiction classic and enjoy arguing with a book's politics.
skipIf: you dislike long lectures on civic philosophy in the middle of a war story.

pairings.reason: A famous reply to this book, which sees the same kind of war as exhausting and pointless.
A modern, funnier descendant with a similar soldier's-eye view of fighting aliens.
Another training-and-war story, with more emphasis on strategy and a much younger hero.
